Standard_Vision.description: Baseline visual spectrum relying on adequate ambient light.

Low_Light_Vision.description: Tapetum lucidum adaptation allowing clear sight in dim conditions (e.g., Felines, Canines).

Darkvision.description: Complete sight in pitch black environments without color (e.g., Cave dwellers, Nocturnal).

Thermal_Vision.description: Detection of infrared heat signatures (e.g., Pit Vipers, certain Bats).

Wide_Angle_Vision.description: Eyes positioned laterally for a near 360-degree field of view (e.g., Ungulates, Rabbits).

Telescopic_Vision.description: High-density fovea for extreme long-distance detail (e.g., Birds of Prey).

Motion_Sensitive.description: Highly tuned to rapid movement, but struggles with stationary objects (e.g., Amphibians, T-Rex).

Compound_Vision.description: Thousands of ommatidia allowing extreme reaction to sudden visual shifts (e.g., Insects, Crustaceans).

Polarized_Vision.description: Filters glare and light refraction, especially over water (e.g., Cephalopods, Mantis Shrimp).

Ultraviolet_Vision.description: Perception of the UV spectrum, tracking biological trails like urine or nectar (e.g., Bees, Avians).

Aquatic_Vision.description: Lenses adapted to correct refractive index errors underwater (e.g., Marine Life, Amphibians).

True_Sight.description: Magical or divine ability to pierce all visual deceit.
